review: 722.3c-1: decisions had B declare no blockers before Jump resolved in the declare attackers step; reordered so Jump resolves first, and added the unblocked Aviator's 2 combat damage to the base expected.

scenarios.title: A prepare spell cannot be cast from the card; only the copy created in exile can be cast

setup.notes: Encouraging Aviator is a 2/3 flying creature whose prepare spell is the instant Jump ({U}: target creature gains flying until end of turn). The stack is empty. The candidates are Jump and Encouraging Aviator.

decisions: The engine evaluates A's candidates; nothing is cast.

variants.label: in_hand
variants.expected: Casting Jump from Encouraging Aviator in A's hand is not legal (can_play false for Jump). Casting Encouraging Aviator as a creature spell for {2}{U} is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: prepared_on_battlefield
variants.delta: Encouraging Aviator is on A's battlefield and prepared, with a copy of Jump in A's exile, instead of in A's hand.
variants.expected: Casting the Jump copy from exile is legal (can_play true, has_legal_target true, legal targets are Encouraging Aviator and Hill Giant, cost {U}). Encouraging Aviator is not castable because it is on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge models the prepare spell as an alternate face (AlternateMode:Prepare, CopyFaceFrom:Jump); the exiled copy exists only while the permanent is prepared.

scenarios.title: Only a permanent with a prepare spell that is not already prepared becomes prepared

setup.notes: Skycoach Waypoint has '{3}, {T}: Target creature becomes prepared.' Encouraging Aviator has a prepare spell (Jump) and is not prepared. Grizzly Bears has no prepare spell.

decisions: A activates Skycoach Waypoint targeting Encouraging Aviator, tapping Skycoach Waypoint and paying {3} by tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: has_prepare_spell
variants.expected: The ability resolves. Encouraging Aviator gains the prepared designation and a copy of Jump is created in A's exile. Exactly one Jump copy is in exile.

variants.label: no_prepare_spell
variants.delta: The ability targets Grizzly Bears instead of Encouraging Aviator.
variants.expected: The ability resolves (Grizzly Bears is a legal target) and does nothing. Grizzly Bears is not prepared and A's exile stays empty.

variants.label: already_prepared
variants.delta: Encouraging Aviator is already prepared, with one copy of Jump in A's exile, before the ability resolves.
variants.expected: The ability resolves and does nothing. Encouraging Aviator stays prepared and A's exile still holds exactly one Jump copy.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the already_prepared variant the prepared state and the exiled copy are set up as in a game where Aviator attacked earlier this turn.

scenarios.title: An unprepare effect removes the prepared designation

setup.notes: Encouraging Aviator is prepared; the Jump in A's exile is its prepare-spell copy. Biblioplex Tomekeeper: 'When it enters, choose up to one: target creature becomes prepared; target creature becomes unprepared.'

decisions: A casts Biblioplex Tomekeeper, tapping four Plains.
Both players pass; Biblioplex Tomekeeper resolves and enters.
A puts its enters trigger on the stack choosing the unprepare mode, targeting Encouraging Aviator.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: unprepare_prepared
variants.expected: The trigger resolves. Encouraging Aviator loses the prepared designation and the Jump copy no longer exists in A's exile (A's exile is empty). Encouraging Aviator stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: unprepare_unprepared
variants.delta: The trigger's unprepare mode targets Grizzly Bears instead of Encouraging Aviator.
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and does nothing to Grizzly Bears. Encouraging Aviator is still prepared and the Jump copy is still in A's exile.

variants.label: prepare_mode
variants.delta: The trigger's mode is 'target creature becomes prepared' instead of unprepared, targeting Encouraging Aviator.
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and does nothing, because Encouraging Aviator is already prepared. It stays prepared and exactly one Jump copy is in A's exile.

scenarios.forge_notes: The prepared state and exiled copy of the base setup are assumed; the same state is reached by attacking with Aviator earlier in the turn.

scenarios.title: Becoming prepared creates a castable copy in exile, and casting it removes the designation

setup.notes: Encouraging Aviator: 'Whenever this creature attacks, it becomes prepared.' Its prepare spell is the instant Jump ({U}: target creature gains flying until end of turn).

decisions: A attacks B with Encouraging Aviator.
Both players pass; the prepare trigger resolves in the declare attackers step.
A casts the Jump copy from exile targeting Hill Giant, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Jump resolves. B declares no blockers and combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: attacks_and_casts
variants.expected: The trigger makes Encouraging Aviator prepared and a copy of Jump (a blue instant with only Jump's characteristics) appears in A's exile. When A casts it, Encouraging Aviator loses the prepared designation and the copy leaves exile as a spell. Jump resolves: Hill Giant has flying until end of turn. A's exile is empty afterwards. Encouraging Aviator deals 2 combat damage to B (B at 18).

variants.label: no_attack
variants.expected: The trigger does not fire. Encouraging Aviator is not prepared, A's exile is empty, and there is no Jump copy to cast. Hill Giant does not gain flying.

variants.label: copy_not_cast
variants.delta: A does not cast the Jump copy.
variants.expected: Encouraging Aviator stays prepared and the Jump copy remains in A's exile at the end of combat. Hill Giant does not gain flying.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's exiled prepare copy may be represented as a ghost card in the exile zone.
